name: EU Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: Higher professional qualifications in the form of a university degree, or advanced ICT skills.
Employment contract of at least 6 months' duration.
Salary at least 1.2 times the average wage in the Slovak economy (reduced to 1.0x for recent graduates, within 3 years of their degree).
Confirmation from the Labour Office that the position qualifies as highly skilled employment (waived if the applicant already holds employment-based residence status).

evidence_required.document: University degree or ICT qualification proof

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, or the confirmation validity period plus 90 days, whichever is shorter

sources.title: IOM Migration Information Centre Slovakia -- EU Blue Card: university degree or advanced ICT skills, 6-month minimum contract, salary 1.2x average wage (1.0x for recent graduates), Labour Office highly-skilled confirmation, 5-year card duration, 180-day application window after confirmation, legal work permitted during processing, Foreign Police decision within 30 days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovakia). STATUS: DRAFT -- IOM (International Organization for Migration) operates Slovakia's official Migration Information Centre under agreement with Slovak authorities and provides detailed, specific figures (1.2x salary multiplier, 5-year duration, 30-day decision window) -- treated as tier-2 consistent with this dataset's convention for UN-agency-operated national information portals, not tier-1 since it is not itself the issuing Slovak authority. work_rights is 'restricted' reflecting the employer/position-tied nature of the confirmation requirement, consistent with this dataset's convention for sponsored work routes generally. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months inferred the same way as sk_work_permit.json.
